title: Way of the Roo

html:
Way of the Roo
Skill Type:  Passive
Trainer:  Fighter
Number of Ranks:  1
Cost to Max:  2227
Increases Melee attack speed but decreases Ranged attack speed and Magic damage.

Way of the Roo is a Passive skill that increases attack speed with Melee weapons but decreases attack speed with Ranged weapons and decreases magic damage. This skill is best used by characters using Melee weapons who do not depend on magic damage skills to deal damage.

This skill currently only has one level, so it can not be upgraded from skill trainers. Below is the description as it appears in the game.


"You were raised by a semi-domesticated pack of kangaroos that taught you the secret art of Kung Roo. Their teachings have provided you with increased attack speed with all Melee weapons. The downside is you pretty much suck with Ranged weapons and your ability to do Magic Damage with skills is also hampered."

  • +25% to Melee Attack Speed
  • -7% to Range Attack Speed
  • -5% to all Magic Damage
